summary: Hancock County steel lookout completed 1914 (36 or 41 ft, sources differ), staffed 1919; FFLOS says no longer standing, removal date not found.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, 36 feet per the 1914 Forest Commissioner's report and the 1920 inventory (one 1914 newspaper item gives 41 feet)
facts.status_note: FFLOS says the tower is no longer standing; the year it came down is not in the sources read, and what remains on the summit is not described

staffing.status: station opened April 14, 1919; no later staffing found in the sources read

corrections.why: The brief's 12.5 m equals 41 feet, the figure from one August 1914 Christian Science Monitor item. The Forest Commissioner's 1914 report gives a new 36-foot steel tower and the 1920 inventory also shows 36 feet, so 36 feet (11.0 m) is the better-supported height. The sources conflict; see resolved_conflicts.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The August 1914 Christian Science Monitor item gives a 41-foot steel look-out; the Forest Commissioner's 1914 report and the 1920 inventory give 36 feet. The story reports both figures and does not settle it.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict: 41 ft in one 1914 newspaper item, 36 ft in the 1914 Forest Commissioner's report and the 1920 inventory; the brief's 12.5 m is the 41-foot figure, so a correction is proposed. The removal date is not in any source read; the status is gone per FFLOS only. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Maine chapter Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet and not readable through fetch, describes the steel tower on the summit as still present in the forest and the watchman's camp as in ruin halfway down. It is not cited and the story does not use it; an editor should check it by hand before anyone says what stands on the summit, because it may conflict with FFLOS 'no longer standing'. The 1914 facts are from newspaper and report text quoted on the Eastern US Lookouts page, not the originals. The 1918-1932 map record is an archive copy; the DigitalMaine catalogue carries the same series.
